description_en: Retrieves a URL for uploading a Skill to OSS. The client uses the returned URL to upload the Skill by performing a PUT request
description_zh: 获取上传 Skill 到 OSS 的 URL，客户端使用返回的 URL 执行 PUT 上传 Skill
name: GetSkillImportFileUrl

parameters.description_en: The Content-Type of the uploaded file. Default value: application/zip.
parameters.description_zh: 上传文件 Content-Type，默认 application/zip
parameters.help_en: The Content-Type of the uploaded file. Default value: application/zip
parameters.help_zh: 上传文件 Content-Type，默认 application/zip
